title: 5496 : fixed UI crash from excessive tick generation with invalid dates/intervals
description:
## Summary

This PR fixes a critical bug where Gantt charts with invalid dates or small tick intervals cause the UI to hang and become completely unresponsive. The issue was caused by a Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ) error and lack of validation for excessive tick generation, leading to infinite loops that freeze the browser.

## Resolves
Resolves #5496

human_comments.body:
The JSDoc comment incorrectly states "Returns the count or Infinity if there would be too many ticks" but the function never returns `Infinity`. It always returns `Math.ceil(timeDiffMs / intervalMs)` regardless of the tick count. The documentation should be updated to reflect that the function simply calculates and returns the estimated tick count.
```suggestion
   * Returns the estimated number of ticks as a number.
```
